Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human D2 dopamine receptor (CHEMBL217) in Homo sapiens assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL217 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Alias the molecule identifier column as compound_chembl_id. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
